text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Private TV channel 2M to extend brodcasts to the whole population starting early next year.
- Association for support of Palestinians to stage peaceful march in Rabat on Oct 7. LE MATIN DU SAHARA
- Commission for promoting employment, which is part of continuing social dialogue, pursues meetings in attempt to tackle unemployment.
- Managing director of former private TV 2M, which has been taken over by the state, says it could be privatised once its finances are straightened out.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri and his Spanish counterpart will discuss illegal immigration and drug trafficking during Basri's visit to Spain.
- U.S. businessmen visit Morocco to consolidate private investments there.
- Association for support of Palestinians ask Moroccans to sign petitions to condemn Israeli aggression and stop normalising relations with it.
- Members of Confederation of Moroccan Businesses visit Gaza strip to study ways of taking part in building the city.
